title: Composition of bounded-below derived direct-image transitions
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, X,Y,Y₂,Y₁ schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], h:Y→X, a₂:Y₂→Y, h₂:Y₂→X, a₁:Y₁→Y₂ and h₁:Y₁→X with a₂≫h=h₂ and a₁≫h₂=h₁. For any bounded-below derived complex K of etale Λ-module sheaves on Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], write t(a,h,h′) for the derived restriction transition used in [sbc-def-base-change-map]. Then t(a₂,h,h₂)(K) followed by t(a₁,h₂,h₁)(a₂^*K), then Rh₁_* applied to the inverse canonical comparison a₁^*a₂^*K→(a₁≫a₂)^*K, equals t(a₁≫a₂,h,h₁)(K). This requires only commutative triangles.

source.place: canonical restriction maps; mateEquiv_vcomp, specialized to identity functors on the common base

proof.text: Eliminate the two triangle witnesses by substitution. Express the first transition as the adjunct of its pullback comparison followed by pullback of the counit. Apply the inverse h₁-adjunction hom-set equivalence to both sides. Use left and right naturality of this equivalence, then naturality of the a₁-comparison, to move the first transition into a₁-pullback. Its inverse adjunct is the original counit composite, by Equiv.symm_apply_apply (the adjunction triangle identities).

Use the already proved source-library upperStarCompDerivedPlus_assoc (WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.UpperStarCompAssoc) on (a₁,a₂,h). It writes the pasted comparison as the comparison for (a₁≫a₂,h) followed by the comparison for (a₁,a₂). Naturality moves the h counit through the latter comparison; composing with its inverse cancels it. The remaining adjunct is the composite transition. Injectivity of the hom-set equivalence proves equality. Equality transports along the two triangle witnesses are eqToIso; proof irrelevance identifies the witnesses.

proof_origin.place: homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, homEquiv_naturality_right_symm, upperStarCompDerivedPlus_assoc; second reading: direct hom-set calculation, not an application of mateEquiv_vcomp

lean.statement: theorem Etale.lowerStarPlusTransition_comp {X Y Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ X) (a₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Y) (h₂ : Y₂ ⟶ X) (wh₂ : a₂ ≫ h = h₂) (a₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂) (h₁ : Y₁ ⟶ X) (wh₁ : a₁ ≫ h₂ = h₁) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) : Etale.lowerStarPlusTransition Λ a₂ h h₂ wh₂ K ≫ Etale.lowerStarPlusTransition Λ a₁ h₂ h₁ wh₁ (D+((a₂)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K) ≫ R+((h₁)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map ((Etale.upperStarPlusComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) a₁ a₂).inv.app K) = Etale.lowerStarPlusTransition Λ (a₁ ≫ a₂) h h₁ (by rw [Category.assoc, wh₂, wh₁]) K
